source_crosschecks.result: The dedicated table schema contains only id, ts, subject, value and quelle; there is no explicit epistemic/transformation/evidence class.

The direct Realtime reader searches the dedicated conversation-memory table and durable_memory; source labels exist, but the inspected interface does not establish typed claim/fact/transformation admission.
Realtime memory read/write wrappers call stern directly in-process; no wrapper-level deterministic MemoryAdmission or epistemic type is inserted before model context use.

semantic_atoms.claim: Conversation memory is stored separately from durable_memory, but its row schema does not distinguish verbatim user claims, model summaries, inferences, instructions or independently verified external facts.

The direct Realtime memory reader exposes heterogeneous conversation-memory and durable-memory material to model context with source labels but without an explicit epistemic/transformation class. Storage separation therefore does not by itself prevent fact-like flattening at retrieval time.

Realtime Function Calling can propose conversation-memory content, but the inspected path lacks deterministic MemoryAdmission semantics that would prevent model-generated summary/inference content from being structurally indistinguishable from a remembered user claim.

architecture_deltas.delta: Introduce MemoryCandidate with immutable source_event_id/utterance_ref, source_actor, transformation_class {VERBATIM,SUMMARY,INFERENCE,INSTRUCTION,OTHER}, epistemic_class {OBSERVED_CLAIM,INFERRED,UNKNOWN,VERIFIED_EXTERNAL only when separately evidenced}, generation, privacy/retention tier and content digest/reference.

Model Function Calling proposes MemoryCandidate only. A deterministic MemoryAdmission decides persistence/redaction/rejection and writes an auditable admission result; it cannot mint factual truth from remembered content.

Retrieval must preserve source + transformation + epistemic + provenance metadata through ranking/context compilation; conversation claims and canonical evidence must never be silently flattened into one fact-like record shape.

epistemic_law: Remembering that actor A said X proves at most OBSERVED_CLAIM(A,X) when the utterance/event is admissibly observed; it does not prove X. A model summary/inference remains SUMMARY/INFERRED until independent evidence promotes a separate factual claim.

contradictions.claim_a: Conversation memory is structurally separate from durable_memory in storage.
contradictions.claim_b: The direct Realtime retrieval interface lacks explicit epistemic/transformation typing and can return heterogeneous memory classes into one model context path.
contradictions.resolution_rule: Keep storage separation but add typed deterministic MemoryAdmission and provenance-preserving retrieval; do not treat source labels as factual authority.

counterhypotheses: Other non-Realtime consumers may add stronger epistemic typing; this delta is scoped to the direct Realtime path and must not be generalized repository-wide without source audit.
Prompt instructions may tell the model to be cautious with memory, but prompt prose does not change row semantics and cannot replace typed admission/provenance.
triggerword4_acceptance_tests: Persist a verbatim user utterance and a model summary of it; retrieval distinguishes them structurally, not only by free-text source labels.
Persist a model inference proposed through Realtime Function Calling; it remains INFERRED/MODEL_CANDIDATE and cannot satisfy an OBSERVED/FACT evidence query.
Retrieve matching conversation-memory and durable-memory records together; every item preserves explicit transformation/epistemic/provenance metadata after ranking/context compilation.
Rejected/redacted sensitive speech leaves an auditable admission result without persisting disallowed raw content.
next_exact_gate: Audit all other conversation/durable-memory consumers for epistemic typing, then feed Triggerword-4 a deterministic MemoryCandidate/MemoryAdmission ABI and provenance-preserving retrieval tests alongside the cross-modal EffectRequest/EffectDecision executor contract.
